L733: #### App-level access tokens
L734: 
L735: App-level API accounts do not come pre-configured with an access token. Each time a store installs your app, BigCommerce initiates a grant code authorization flow to help your app generate a dedicated access token for that store. For further details, see cite357†Authenticating an app .

L121: ## Manage MCP access and sessions
L122: 
L123: Stripe’s MCP server uses OAuth to authorize clients according to the [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/basic/authorization#2-1-1-oauth-grant-types). OAuth lets you grant and revoke access without sharing an API key with the client.
L124: When you connect an MCP client, it opens Stripe’s OAuth consent page. Use this page to authorize the client to access your Stripe data. After you authorize an MCP client with OAuth, you can manage its session in the Stripe Dashboard.
L125: 
L126: If your organization manages your device or network, your IT administrator might block connections to external MCP servers. When the Stripe MCP server doesn’t connect in a managed environment, ask your IT department to allow `mcp.stripe.com`.
L127: ### Manage your sessions
L128: 
L129: Your authorized MCP clients appear under **OAuth sessions** in your [user settings](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/user). To revoke a session:
L130: 
L131: 1. Find the client in the **OAuth sessions** list.
L132: 2. Click the overflow menu (⋯).
L133: 3. Select **Revoke access**.
L134: ### Manage sessions as an administrator
L135: 
L136: To view or revoke another user’s sessions, your role must include permissions to manage team members and OAuth sessions. The **Administrator** role includes these permissions.
L137: 1. Open [Team and security](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/team) in the Dashboard.
L138: 2. Select the team member you want to manage.
L139: 3. Find the **OAuth sessions** table.
L140: 4. To revoke one session, click its overflow menu and select **Revoke access**. To revoke every listed session, select **Revoke all**.

L224: ## Best Practices to Maintain Security of My Private Integration Tokencite71†​ L225: 
L226: We recommend that you rotate your Private Integration tokens every 90 days.
L227: ### How to rotate your token:cite72†​ L228: 
L229: Step 1: Navigate to Private Integrations under settings, and click on the Private Integration you have created.
L230: Step 2: Click on "Rotate and expire this token later".
L231: Step 3: Click "Continue" in response to the warning message if you are sure that you want to proceed with rotation.
L232: Step 4: Copy the new token and update it on your third-party app.
L233: You will have a 7-day window where both the old and the new tokens will continue to work. After 7 days, the old token will expire.
L234: 
L235: During this window, you can:
L236: 
L237:   * "Cancel rotation" if your developer needs more time.
L238:   * "Expire Now" if the third party app has been updated.
L239: 
L240: * * *
L241: ## What if my token has been compromised?cite73†​ L242: 
L243: Step 1: Navigate to Private Integrations under settings, and click on the Private Integration you have created.
L244: Step 2: Click on "Rotate and expire this token now".
L245: Step 3: Click "Continue" in response to the warning message if you are sure that you want to proceed with rotation.
L246: Step 4: Copy the new token and update it on your third-party app.
L247: 
L248: > Note: Don't forget to copy the token generated as you won't be able to do it again later.

L251: ## Can I edit the Private Integration permissions without updating the token?cite74†​ L252: 
L253: Yes, you can edit the Private Integration name, description and scopes/permissions any time after you've created it.
L254: 
L255: How:
L256:   1. Navigate to Private Integrations under settings, and select "Edit" from the three-dot menu.
L257:   2. Update the Private Integration name and description if required. Click on "Next".
L258:   3. If required, update the scopes/permissions that you want the private integration to have access to on your account. Ensure that you are selecting only the required scopes for better data security. Click on "Update" to save the updates made.
L259: > Note: Updating the Private Integration details does not generate a new token. The existing token will continue to work.
